vulns.title: Unauth order query IDOR (tradeNo / contact)
vulns.detail: keywords=18-digit tradeNo OR exact contact returns order row. For status=1 and empty query-password, upstream also returns secret field (confirmed via source + unpaid PoC shape).

vulns.title: Unauth secret lookup binds orderId=tradeNo
vulns.detail: Live API requires POST field orderId set to the 18-digit tradeNo (not numeric id). Unpaid → 该订单还未支付; paid+correct/empty password → secret.

vulns.title: Guest unpaid checkout (Xunhupay)
vulns.detail: commodity_id+pay_id=3 (微信个人支付/Xunhupay) creates orders without login; yields tradeNo for query/secret PoC.

vulns.title: Open registration without captcha
vulns.detail: Register succeeds without captcha; login requires image captcha (2captcha OK).
